svg.title: QuantizeToFp8Kernel on one row
svg.text: QuantizeToFp8Kernel on one row: layer 14 down_proj, row 0 (blockIdx.x = 0), cols = 8,960
256 threads; thread t reads i = t, t + 256, … (35 weights each). Colour: the weight's sign and size.
Ticks: E4M3 values around |w / scale| (dot); amber: the one stored. The largest weight lands on 448. Steps
grow with the size, so the error is at most 1/16 of the weight, down to 2^-6; below that, steps are 2^-9.
each thread's largest |w| over its share of the row
BlockMax gives every thread the row's largest; scale maps it to 448
every weight divided by the scale, rounded to the nearest E4M3 byte
thread 0 stores the scale; MatVec multiplies each row's sum by it
